Power Manager Exported Types

group POWER_MANAGER_Exported_Types

Typedefs

typedef enum POWER_CheckResult POWER_CheckResult

This enum is used for DLPS callback check.

typedef POWER_CheckResult (*POWERCheckFunc)()

This callback function is used for modules, which need to be checked before entering DLPS.

typedef void (*POWERStageFunc)()

This callback function is used for modules, which need to be executed before entering or after exiting from DLPS.

Enums

enum POWER_CheckResult

This enum is used for DLPS callback check.

Values:

enumerator POWER_CHECK_PEND

Callback check failed, but restart DLPS check flow.

enumerator POWER_CHECK_FAIL

Callback check failed, and CPU enters sleep mode.

enumerator POWER_CHECK_PASS

Callback check passed, and continue the other check callback functions which have been registered before.

enum T_BT_POWER_MODE

BT power mode struct.

Values:

enumerator BTPOWER_DEEP_SLEEP

BT deep sleep mode, DSM.

enumerator BTPOWER_ACTIVE

BT active mode.

enum POWERStage

Power stage struct.

Values:

enumerator POWER_STAGE_STORE

Stage of entering DLPS.

enumerator POWER_STAGE_RESTORE

Stage of exiting DLPS.

enum T_SYSTEM_POWER_MODE

Platform power mode struct.

Values:

enumerator POWER_POWERDOWN_MODE

Power down mode, can be woken up only by PAD and LPC, PAD debounce wake-up must be disabled in power-down mode.

enumerator POWER_DLPS_MODE

DLPS mode, deep low power state.

enumerator POWER_ACTIVE_MODE

Active mode, system will keep in active mode.

enumerator POWER_MODE_MAX

Max power mode number.

enum POWERDlpsMode

Sub mode of DLPS.

Values:

enumerator POWER_DLPS_PFM_MODE

DLPS PFM mode.

enumerator POWER_DLPS_RET_MODE

DLPS LDO mode.

enumerator PM_WAKEUP_RTC

User RTC wake up from DLPS.

enumerator PM_WAKEUP_MAC

MAC wake up from DLPS.

enumerator PM_WAKEUP_GPIO

GPIO wake up from DLPS.

enumerator PM_WAKEUP_REASON_USB

USB wake up from DLPS.

enumerator PM_WAKEUP_REASON_LPCOMP

LPC wake up from DLPS.

enumerator PM_WAKEUP_REASON_AON_QUAD_DEC

AON QDecoder wake up from DLPS.

enumerator PM_WAKEUP_DEF_MAX

enum PowerModeErrorCode

Error code of not entering DLPS.

Values:

enumerator PM_ERROR_UNKNOWN

Unknown error.

enumerator PM_ERROR_POWER_MODE

Power mode is not low power mode.

enumerator PM_ERROR_DISABLE_DLPS_TIME

The number of entries and exits of DLPS has exceeded the maximum allowed limit, when max allow count is set.

enumerator PM_ERROR_32K_CHECK_LOCK

32k clock check fail.

enumerator PM_ERROR_LOG_DMA_NOT_IDLE

Log DMA is not idle.

enumerator PM_ERROR_LOG_BUFFER_NOT_EMPTY

Log buffer is not empty.

enumerator PM_ERROR_CALLBACK_CHECK

Check callback function return false.

enumerator PM_ERROR_INTERRUPT_OCCURRED

Interrupt occurred in check flow.

enumerator PM_ERROR_WAKEUP_TIME

Next wake-up time interval is too small.

enumerator PM_ERROR_ERROR_OCCUPIED_TIME

Power manager can not request next wake-up time interval as power manager slave is currently occupied.
